protocol_revision_note: Replaced the zero-outcome draft's record-wise folds and 32-world power placeholder with disjoint world-level calibration/development roles. No v2 efficacy outcome existed before this revision.
role: prospective mechanistic-synthetic exposed development only; never archive validation, EPA, validation, test, primary, or confirmation
objective: Test whether correctly composed citizen-public innovation variance and causally published residual forcing repair bounded citizen assimilation without changing the original scientific gates.

historical_reuse.scope: Historical v4 evidence remains authoritative only for its unchanged mechanisms. This development family addresses the changed estimator gate only.

calibration.truth_use: closed labels for Vs, Vp and Cps only

development.truth_use: scoring only after prediction artifacts are written and hashed

runtime_smoke.scope: complete registered matrix for this development seed; retained as development evidence and resumed, never rerun with a replacement seed

seed_namespace.pre_registration_collision_audit: no prior occurrence in registered namespaces

producer.operator_storage: one CSR physical operator per world identity, never a dense time-by-cell-by-cell tensor

synthetic_boundary.physical_state_equation: x_t = F x_(t-1) + u_t + w_t for t>=1, where w_t includes Gaussian innovation and any nonnegative-projection correction
synthetic_boundary.initialization: epoch 0 is a boundary and is never treated as a transition row
synthetic_boundary.residual_identity: z_t = F z_(t-1) + [u_t + F p_(t-1) - p_t] + w_t
synthetic_boundary.public_forcing_clock: u_t is released at epoch t to every arm; an offline bundle stores all rows with per-row availability, while the estimator objective reads only the current closed prefix
synthetic_boundary.public_center_clock: p_t is available after on-time epoch-t regulatory arrivals and before the epoch-t twin update
synthetic_boundary.calibration_truth: allowed only in eight disjoint clean calibration worlds to freeze scalar covariance summaries
synthetic_boundary.development_truth: stored in separate scoring-only files and loaded only after prediction files are written and hashed
synthetic_boundary.attacks: white-box stress generation may use latent truth, but attack/corruption labels never enter producer fitting, scales, forcing or estimator inputs

covariance_calibration.pairing: selected clean citizen observation and causal public prediction at the same acquisition epoch and cell
covariance_calibration.sensor_error: post-measurement-clipping citizen value minus calibration truth
covariance_calibration.public_error: frozen causal public center minus calibration truth
covariance_calibration.independence_variance: world-fold-weighted Vs + Vp with Cps fixed to zero
covariance_calibration.cross_fitted_variance: world-fold-weighted Vs + Vp - 2 Cps; each fold estimate excludes the held world

same_information_controls.parity: For one seed, cell and candidate, all four methods receive one byte-identical input fingerprint; PUBLIC ignores citizen inputs only after the fingerprint is committed.

selection_and_exit.rule: A candidate is eligible only if every aggregate scientific gate and every per-run correctness/resource invariant passes. Nominate at most one by minimum worst normalized condition loss, then smaller innovation scale, then lower runtime, then lexicographic id.
selection_and_exit.no_feasible_candidate: Close v2 and retain every adverse outcome; do not alter family, cap, delta, lag, gates, seeds, producer or controls.
selection_and_exit.downstream: A development nomination can motivate a separately frozen validation registration only; it cannot open EPA test, primary or confirmation.

runtime.resume: only missing hash-identical jobs; scientific failures are never replaced by new seeds
